extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: counterbalance forklift, approx. 3.8 x 1.2 x 2.3 m (L x W x H), fork length 1.15 m
extras.notes: front (forks) faces -Y; 'forklift_fork_carriage' (carriage, load backrest and forks) is a separate object with its origin at the fork heel on the ground: translate along Z to lift (0 to approx. 0.9 m stays inside the fixed mast); 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll), the rear wheels steer around local Z; open operator station with visible seat and steering wheel; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
